name: EPIC 220311188
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.7 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,405 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,633 K at its surface.
